commands.name: Install source to local Maven repository
commands.script:
set -euo pipefail
if [ ! -x /usr/java/temurin-8/bin/java ]; then
 mkdir -p /usr/java/temurin-8
 curl -fL --retry 3 --connect-timeout 20 --max-time 600 https://api.adoptium.net/v3/binary/latest/8/ga/linux/x64/jdk/hotspot/normal/eclipse -o /usr/java/temurin8.tar.gz
 tar -xzf /usr/java/temurin8.tar.gz -C /usr/java/temurin-8 --strip-components=1
fi
export JAVA_HOME=/usr/java/temurin-8
export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH"
if [ -f build.txt ]; then cat build.txt; fi
git rev-parse HEAD
mvn clean install -DskipTests -Dgpg.skip=true
